transcribed_question:
(A) What structure attaches to the area painted "pink"?
(B) List two features of the vertebrae in question?

marker.description: Pink paint marking a roughened area on the vertebral body

main_question: What structure attaches to the area painted "pink"?
main_explanation: The pink-marked rough area is on the anterior surface of the vertebral body, which provides attachment for the anterior longitudinal ligament.

supporting_question.question: Which feature is characteristic of a thoracic vertebra?
options: Large kidney-shaped body without costal facets
Presence of costal facets for rib articulation
Bifid spinous process in all thoracic vertebrae
supporting_question.explanation: Thoracic vertebrae have costal facets for articulation with ribs.

true_false.statement: The anterior longitudinal ligament is attached to the anterior surfaces of the vertebral bodies.
true_false.explanation: This ligament runs along the anterior aspect of the vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs.
